sql.propToolProposal.getAllForCompany: select *, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(adders))) FROM ( SELECT pa.adder_id as "id", ad.adder_name FROM props.proposal_adder pa inner join props.adder ad on ad.id = pa.adder_id WHERE pa.proposal_id = p.id) adders), '[]') AS "adders" from props.proposal p where p.company_id = :companyId
sql.propToolProposal.getOne: select *, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(adders))) FROM ( SELECT pa.adder_id as "id", ad.adder_name FROM props.proposal_adder pa inner join props.adder ad on ad.id = pa.adder_id WHERE pa.proposal_id = p.id) adders), '[]') AS "adders" from props.proposal p where p.id = :id
sql.propToolProposal.insert: insert into props.proposal(project_id, company_id, state_id, utility_company_id, panel_id, inverter_id, aurora_design_id, customer_name, address, city, zip_code, phone, email, product_id, promotion, notes, proposal_created_by, qa_completed_by, monitor, loan_term, interest_rate, number_of_ecobees, number_of_leds, number_of_panels, down_payment, year_output, proposal_number, production_factor, total_system_price, offset_val, created_by_id) values (:projectId, :companyId, :stateId, :utilityCompanyId, :panelId, :inverterId, :auroraDesignId, :customerName, :address, :city, :zipCode, :phone, :email, :productId, :promotion, :notes, :proposalCreatedBy, :qaCompletedBy, :monitor, :loanTerm, :interestRate, :numberOfEcobees, :numberOfLeds, :numberOfPanels, :downPayment, :yearOutput, :proposalNumber, :productionFactor, :totalSystemPrice, :offsetVal, :createdById)
sql.propToolProposal.update: update props.proposal set project_id = :projectId, state_id = :stateId, utility_company_id = :utilityCompanyId, panel_id = :panelId, inverter_id = :inverterId, aurora_design_id = :auroraDesignId, customer_name = :customerName, address = :address, city = :city, zip_code = :zipCode, phone = :phone, email = :email, product_id = :productId, promotion = :promotion, notes = :notes, proposal_created_by = :proposalCreatedBy, qa_completed_by = :qaCompletedBy, monitor = :monitor, loan_term = :loanTerm, interest_rate = :interestRate, number_of_ecobees = :numberOfEcobees, number_of_leds = :numberOfLeds, number_of_panels = :numberOfPanels, year_output = :yearOutput, down_payment = :downPayment, total_system_price = :totalSystemPrice, offset_val = :offsetVal, production_factor = :productionFactor, modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :id
sql.propToolProposal.search: select *, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(adders))) FROM ( SELECT pa.id, pa.adder_id, ad.adder_name FROM props.proposal_adder pa inner join props.adder ad on ad.id = pa.adder_id WHERE pa.proposal_id = p.id) adders), '[]') AS "adders" from props.proposal p where p.company_id = :companyId and p.customer_name ilike '%' || :query || '%' order by p.date_created desc limit :limit offset :offset
sql.propToolProposal.searchCount: select count(*) from props.proposal p where p.company_id = :companyId and p.customer_name ilike '%' || :query || '%'
sql.propToolProposal.exportProposalLog: select id, project_id, proposal_number, number_of_panels, panel_wattage, annual_production, annual_usage, date_created from props.proposal_log where archived = false and date_created between :startDate and :endDate
sql.propToolProposal.import.sqlId: select case when seq.last_value >= 9999 then setval('props.proposal_excel_id_seq', 1000) else nextval('props.proposal_excel_id_seq') end as prop_id from props.proposal_excel_id_seq seq
